cross_lane_convergences.finding: Every lane converged on provenance as traceability only. Entity, activity, and agent identifiers must not be promoted into validation, identity proof, or source truth.
Rows that mention measurement technique must also specify a bounded measurand and uncertainty model; otherwise they remain held.
Convention rows can harden notation and boundary-policy requirements but cannot derive scalar EOM, T_Psi_mu_nu, conservation, or null recovery.
B_Psi remains demoted until a separate definition artifact fixes role, rank, units, source authority, and null behavior.
Consciousness and meaning proxy rows require explicit false-positive routes and discriminants before they can even be treated as protocol-ready.
